stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 17 hours and pipe B can fill it in 12 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/17$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/12$. Combined rate $= 1/17 + 1/12 = 0.1422$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/17+1/12} = 7.03$ hours.
